name: week-picker
title: Week picker
description: Pick a whole week for timesheets and reports: Week 43 with its dates, arrows to step, and a grid where a click on any day takes the row.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { start, end, week, year } with ISO dates; only value.start is read, and week counts in its own year (2025-12-29 is week 1 of 2026). numbering is iso (Monday start) or us (Sunday start). Without now the browser's clock is read, so the server renders no today marker.
